en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a lakeside hotel with three stories and dormer windows labeled "HOTEL DE PLASMOLEN" on its facade. In the foreground, people are rowing small boats on a calm lake. Along the shore in front of the hotel, numerous people sit at outdoor tables and stroll by the water, with trees framing the scene. At the top in red print is a caption identifying the hotel and its location near Nijmegen.
